verdicts.note: Wikipedia says the Mississippi watershed drains 32 US states (not 31).

fix.question: Longest river system in North America (with its main tributary the Missouri), it drains all or parts of 32 US states and flows down through Memphis and New Orleans into the Gulf of Mexico. Name it.
fix.explanation: About 2,340 miles long; with the Missouri it forms the longest river system in North America; immortalised by Mark Twain in his Huck Finn stories.
